title: Godot continually crashing in 4.6 RC1 due to Steam Fossilize (Windows 11, Vulkan)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible infrequently: Godot 4.5.1
Reproducible frequently: Godot 4.6 beta 3
Reproducible to the point of not being able to use: Godot 4.6 RC1

### System information

OS: Windows 11 - Godot 4.6 RC1 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 GRE (AMD, v25.12.1) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700x - 64GB of Memory

### Issue description

I first noticed this in 4.6 beta 3 but has gotten much worse in 4.6 RC1. I did have some crashing in 4.5.1, though it didn't happen frequent enough to be annoying and create a bug ticket.

Godot continually is crashing randomly, sometime in my title screen (very limited 3D usage here or loading in my main 3D or just being paused in my 3D main scene. I have also had it crash when there is no game playing, no scenes are open, the editor is just open. It seems an issue with the Vulkan connection from my limited knowledge of GPUs. ### Steps to reproduce

Hard to know what exactly is triggering this. If this is critical, I can try and put together a small project that has the majority of things. Though it seems in general it's gotten worse since I've switched to 4.6 and added the new IK flows to my 3d characters (which are in my title screen). Though again, I've had this happen with nothing open but the editor and no scenes, so I'm really not sure if this is hardware or software, or perhaps some config in my editor settings?
